review_notes: I read the whole file. It has only theorems and no definitions or structures: three results about sequences in a normalized GCD domain and their ℤ specialisation. The hypotheses are written inline as `a m ∣ a (m + j) - a j`, so the file does not introduce its own version of a concept. I grepped Mathlib and found `Nat.IsStrongDvdSeq` in Mathlib/Data/Nat/DvdSequence.lean, but it applies only to `ℕ → ℕ`. The target works over a general GCD domain, with the `ℤ` corollary using `natAbs`, and it does not redefine the Nat notion. The only overlap is possible theorem-level duplication of conclusions, which the rubric excludes. I did not check every Mathlib lemma individually. I found no justified finding.
